description: Returns a compact accessibility-tree page map for locating interactive and semantic elements.

pageId.description: Page ID whose compact page map should be returned.

id.description: Canonical element ID used to scope the AX tree to a specific subtree.

selector.description: CSS selector used to scope the AX tree to the first matching element in the main frame.

purpose.description: Describe why you need the current page map, e.g., understanding page structure, locating an actionable target, checking enabled/checked/layout state, or refreshing canonical element ids

lines.description: Compact accessibility-tree lines for the current page and included frames.

nodeCount.description: Number of accessibility nodes represented in lines.

frameCount.description: Number of frames represented in the page map.

truncated.description: Whether the page map was truncated by the configured output limit.

resolutionSource.description: Target resolution route used when a target was requested.

recoveredTarget.description: Snapshot details used when a stale target was recovered.

observation.description: Factual observation of the completed Action and its current visible result.

suggested_prompt.description: Action-specific next-step guidance based on the returned result.

lines.description: Compact accessibility-tree lines for the current page and included frames.

nodeCount.description: Number of accessibility nodes represented in lines.

frameCount.description: Number of frames represented in the page map.

truncated.description: Whether the page map was truncated by the configured output limit.

resolutionSource.description: Target resolution route used when a target was requested.

recoveredTarget.description: Snapshot details used when a stale target was recovered.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.

observation.description: Factual observation that does not expose private runtime diagnostics.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

details.description: Action-specific public details; private execution diagnostics are omitted.
